per_candidate.id: s2:Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) 12CO(2–1) Gas Dynamics in NG, 2026-10-08

rationale: The candidate paper 2310.11296 investigates the gas dynamics around a supermassive black hole, which is relevant to understanding accretion processes, although it does not fully address the relationship between accretion timescale and black hole mass or gas mass.
